subject: Recording + slides from our demo — quick 10-minute Q&A?
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@sundialtech.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Recording + slides from our demo — quick 10-minute Q&A?

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through how Redwood can reduce token spend and stabilize latency for your ingestion pipeline. Quick recap from my side:

- What we saw: ~35% lower per-token cost in typical batch runs with prefix caching enabled.
- Short-term win: deploy a compatible model variant to proof 1–2 low-latency endpoints for the analytics team.
- Next steps we discussed: pricing estimate, sample SLA for Dedicated, and a short engineering Q&A for on-prem constraints.

I captured the recording and slides from today — attaching both plus a link below so you can share internally. If it helps, I can do a 10-minute focused Q&A to answer the technical/permitting questions you mentioned (on-prem support, KMS integration, logging retention). Would any of these work for you?

- Tue 11/24 — 10:00–10:10 PT
- Fri 11/27 — 11:00–11:10 PT

If those don't work, reply with a time that suits you and I will send a calendar invite.

Attachments: sundial-demo-recording.mp4 (recording, 8m), Redwood-demo-slides-SundialTech.pdf (12 slides)
Links: https://drive.google.com/file/d/recording-sundial-demo

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0182

Sorry for the delayed reply — the recordings/slides were helpful and I've shared them with our platform and security leads. A couple quick questions before we lock a slot:

1) Do you have a short doc on typical procurement timelines / contract templates for Dedicated or Private deployments? Our legal team will want to see MX clauses and data retention language.
2) For an initial POC, can we start with a single-node on-prem sandbox (air-gapped) and then expand to VPC-hosted Dedicated if things look good? Any caveats on performance testing in air-gapped mode?

We can do Fri 11/27 at 11:00 PT for a 10-minute Q&A — that works for Tom (procurement) and me. Please include anyone from your side who can answer the KMS/audit log questions.

Thanks,
